title: Release SemVer evidence pack (v1)
description: Deterministic, bounded evidence collected between the previous release tag (or the declared first-release candidate) and one exact source commit. It carries no version decision. Its evidence_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON form of the whole document; v1 contains no JSON numbers.
$comment: Immutable once released. Any change requires a new vN directory and MANIFEST entry. Consumers must also reject documents larger than 262144 UTF-8 bytes.

source_commit.description: Exact 40-character lowercase Git commit the evidence was collected at.

previous_tag.description: Previous canonical release tag, or null when no release tag exists yet. How a null previous tag is treated is an unresolved owner decision (ADR 0137).

declared_version.description: The [project].version declared in pyproject.toml at source_commit. Input evidence only; it is not an output version.

api_surface_inspected.description: True only when the public API surface was actually inspected. Mirrors the .github#2260 evidence-pack rule.

evidence_ref.description: Stable, namespaced evidence identifier, for example commit:<sha> or api:removed:<symbol>.
